mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1, indicating strengthening economic demand, boosts consumer and business confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of quarters with positive GDPC1 growth, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.0%, signaling a tightening monetary cycle, investors become risk-averse, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.0%, or walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Jointly, when UNRATE falls below 3.5% and PAYEMS growth accelerates (> 200k new jobs), a tight labor market fuels wage inflation, pressuring margins and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 55% of instances when both conditions are met, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in INDPRO, indicating improved industrial production, enhances economic efficiency, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, but only during non-recessionary periods.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 50% of non-recessionary quarters with positive INDPRO growth, or Rank IC < 0.025 over any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A surge in HOUST (> 10% YoY), signaling robust housing demand, spills over into broader consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 55% of instances when HOUST > 10% YoY, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.02 over any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Always, a low FEDFUNDS (< 1.5%) environment, indicative of accommodative monetary policy, supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.035 over any 3-year rolling window, or SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 1.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE rises (> 0.5% in 3 months) and PAYEMS growth decelerates (< 100k new jobs), a weakening labor market foreshadows economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 0.5% in 3 months and PAYEMS growth < 100k
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances when both conditions are met, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.04 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Jointly, when RSAFS increases (> 5% MoM) and CPIAUCSL remains stable (< 0.2% MoM), real consumer spending power is enhanced, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 50% of instances when both conditions are met, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
